about: REAL road times between each map's points: Google Maps Routes computeRouteMatrix, DRIVE, TRAFFIC_UNAWARE. A map named by a seed holds SYNTHETIC points (planner.synthetic_coords); 'kerala' holds 70 real public PHC/FHC sites from OpenStreetMap (kerala_phcs.json, ODbL 1.0, (c) OpenStreetMap contributors), in that file's order. arcs: [origin, destination, seconds, metres], same-state pairs only; a pair missing here gets the straight-line estimate. Add maps: python -m anumaan.planner --seeds 5-9 --fetch-routes
